summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path, SHACLPathError) and tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. test/test_path.py and test/test_extras pass with the prepared venv (42 passed for the new and path tests; 100 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed for test_extras). Nothing committed. mypy, black and isort are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement, line lengths (<=88) and import order were checked by reading only. The test file changed on disk mid-session; I kept the current version and re-ran the tests.
